purpose: Source-backed Stage 6 projection remediation candidates. These are not active production rules and do not alter approved Stage 6 packages until the normal review/hash/approval workflow is rerun.

candidates.defect: Both current Stage 6 treaty rules have identical applicability conditions (beneficial_owner == true) despite Article 12(2) assigning different rates by royalty category.

recommended_projection.source_basis: Article 12(2)(a): 10% for ordinary copyright other than the film/broadcast category in subparagraph (b), patents, trademarks, designs/models/plans, secret formula/process, equipment and industrial/commercial/scientific experience.
Article 12(2)(b): 15% for copyright in cinematographic films and films or recordings for television or radio broadcasting.

candidates.release_requirement: Regenerate structured rules, review package hash and Stage 6 approval metadata; then replace the known-defect allowlist entry with real-rule regression tests.

candidates.defect: The 10% catch-all branch is encoded as literal royalty_category == other, but the approved source representation says 10% applies in all cases other than industrial/commercial/scientific equipment.
candidates.release_requirement: Replace the overloaded literal other enum with an explicit complement category, regenerate review package hash and Stage 6 approval metadata, and add real-rule atomic-category tests.
